name: Balsamic Glazed Pork Chops
ingredients: Optional: crumbled goats cheese or feta, fresh parsley or thyme
why: Verified 417 cal / 15.2g carbs / 52.7g protein per serving - clears the band with a very high protein-to-cal ratio. Distinct balsamic-reduction angle vs the creamy pork chops already pooled. Sear-and-reduce skillet, scales to 14. Carbs come from balsamic + brown sugar reduction; both map to the board (balsamic-vinegar, brown-sugar tracked). Note goat cheese is optional garnish only.
